{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse in cream (#f5f0e6), relaxed fit with a soft collar reaching mid-thigh, lightweight woven fabric.
Wide-leg trousers in charcoal heather (#3e3f42), tailored through the hip tapering to an ankle length, fine wool-blend material.
Leather loafers in chocolate brown (#5c4a3d), classic cap-toe design with minimal hardware, soft calfskin.
Gold bar necklace in 18k finish (#ffd700), simple geometric pendant resting on the collarbone, polished metal.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance for a daytime dinner date by blending refined textures with understated elegance suitable for an autumn evening. The cream blouse and charcoal trousers create a sophisticated neutral palette that complements her warm skin tones without appearing overly formal for a casual restaurant setting. Soft loafers add comfort for an extended night out while maintaining a polished silhouette, allowing her to feel confident and relaxed throughout the dinner."}
